## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change. Link the relevant issue when available.

## Scope and compatibility

List affected components and any public API, protocol, persistence, concurrency or resource-boundary changes. Explain significant tradeoffs.

## Validation

List exact commands, toolchains, platforms and actual results. Include failures and skips. Identify checks not run and the reason; adding a test or
workflow is not an executed result. See tests/README.md for supported entries.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and preserves documented contracts or explains intentional changes.
- [ ] Relevant tests and user-facing documentation are included.
- [ ] Generated files and dependency changes identify their inputs and versions.
- [ ] No build outputs, caches, real credentials or raw evidence archives are included.
- [ ] Contributions follow CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
